title: SolderPop IDE theme
description: Colour theme for the SolderPop IDE. Missing colours fall back to the built-in theme of the same "type".

id.description: Unique id; also the file name (<id>.json).

name.description: Name shown in the theme picker.

type.description: Picks the built-in theme used for any missing colour.

window.background.title: Window background
window.background.description: Main window frame and any panel without a more specific background.

window.foreground.title: Default text
window.foreground.description: Text colour used wherever no more specific foreground is set.

window.titleBar.background.title: Title bar
window.titleBar.background.description: Title bar strip at the top of the window and panel headers.

window.border.title: Borders & separators
window.border.description: Lines between panels, menubar bottom border, sidebar edges.

dialog.light.background.title: Light dialog background
dialog.light.background.description: Background of light modal dialogs (e.g. confirmations).

menubar.background.title: Menubar background
menubar.background.description: Top menubar and its dropdown menus.

menubar.foreground.title: Menubar text
menubar.foreground.description: Menu titles, dropdown items and hotkey hints.

menubar.item.hover.background.title: Menu item hover
menubar.item.hover.background.description: Menu title or dropdown item under the mouse.

menubar.item.active.background.title: Open menu background
menubar.item.active.background.description: Top-level menu title while its dropdown is open.

menubar.item.active.foreground.title: Open menu text
menubar.item.active.foreground.description: Top-level menu title text while its dropdown is open.

tabs.background.title: Tab strip background
tabs.background.description: Strip behind the open patch tabs.

tabs.item.inactive.background.title: Inactive tab
tabs.item.inactive.background.description: Patch tabs that are not currently shown. The active tab uses the canvas background.

tabs.item.hover.background.title: Tab hover
tabs.item.hover.background.description: Inactive patch tab under the mouse.

tabs.item.foreground.title: Tab text
tabs.item.foreground.description: Inactive tab titles. The active tab title uses the accent colour.

sidebar.background.title: Sidebar background
sidebar.background.description: Project browser, inspector and helpbox panels.

sidebar.foreground.title: Sidebar text
sidebar.foreground.description: Patch names, inspector labels and other sidebar text.

sidebar.subtitle.foreground.title: Sidebar secondary text
sidebar.subtitle.foreground.description: Secondary lines such as library names and patch descriptions.

sidebar.item.hover.background.title: Sidebar row hover
sidebar.item.hover.background.description: Project browser row under the mouse.

sidebar.item.selected.hover.background.title: Sidebar selected row hover
sidebar.item.selected.hover.background.description: Selected project browser row under the mouse.

workspace.background.title: Empty workspace
workspace.background.description: Area shown when no patch is open.

canvas.background.title: Canvas background
canvas.background.description: Patch canvas, also used for the active patch tab.

canvas.gridlines.title: Canvas grid
canvas.gridlines.description: Grid lines drawn on the patch canvas.

canvas.highlight.title: Hover highlight
canvas.highlight.description: Outline and handles of hovered nodes, pins, links and comments.

node.body.background.title: Node body
node.body.background.description: Fill of node rectangles on the canvas.

node.border.title: Node outline
node.border.description: Outline of nodes and the pin connectors drawn on them.

node.title.foreground.title: Node title
node.title.foreground.description: Node name text drawn inside the node.

node.watch.foreground.title: Watch node value
node.watch.foreground.description: Live value text shown inside watch nodes.

node.pin.label.title: Pin label
node.pin.label.description: Pin names next to pin circles.

comment.foreground.title: Comment text
comment.foreground.description: Text of comment blocks on the canvas.

comment.resizeHandle.title: Comment resize handle
comment.resizeHandle.description: Corner handle used to resize comment blocks.

input.background.title: Input background
input.background.description: Text fields, dropdowns and inspector widgets.

input.option.highlighted.background.title: Highlighted option
input.option.highlighted.background.description: Keyboard-highlighted option in dropdowns and autocomplete lists.

button.dark.background.title: Dark button
button.dark.background.description: Default buttons in dialogs and panels.

deployPanel.background.title: Panel background
deployPanel.background.description: Deployment / debugger panel at the bottom of the window.

deployPanel.foreground.title: Panel text
deployPanel.foreground.description: Log output and labels in the deployment panel.

deployPanel.titleBar.background.title: Panel title bar
deployPanel.titleBar.background.description: Header strip of the deployment panel.

deployPanel.titleBar.foreground.title: Panel title text
deployPanel.titleBar.foreground.description: Title and toolbar icons in the deployment panel header.

deployPanel.tabs.background.title: Panel tabs
deployPanel.tabs.background.description: Tab strip (Installation, Compiler, Uploader, …) in the deployment panel.

deployPanel.item.hover.background.title: Panel hover
deployPanel.item.hover.background.description: Tabs and toolbar buttons in the deployment panel under the mouse.

deployPanel.input.foreground.title: Serial input text
deployPanel.input.foreground.description: Text typed into the serial monitor input.

accent.primary.title: Accent / selection
accent.primary.description: Brand accent: selected nodes and links, active tab title, focused inputs.

error.accent.title: Error
error.accent.description: Outlines, badges and backgrounds that mark errors.
